Mods

A skill changes what your agent knows to do. A mod changes Claude Code itself: what it shows you, and what it does between your turns.

  • Each mod is its own plugin, in the same marketplace as the skills.
  • You install each one on its own, only the ones you want.
  • No skill depends on a mod: the atelier works the same without them.

The mods

  • claimv0.1.0

    Guard a tree with more than one writer: the mod notices files that changed while this session was idle, tells the model once, and refuses sweeping git commands while those files are dirty.

    /plugin install claim --marketplace LeSplooch/tbaguette-skills
    Meet claim→

  • climbv0.1.2

    Run a goal as a climb: the mod runs your check after every turn, logs score and timing, protects named files, and queues the next iteration until the check passes or a stop condition fires.

    /plugin install climb --marketplace LeSplooch/tbaguette-skills
    Meet climb→

  • meterv0.1.0

    One quiet line for the session's numbers: context, rate-limit windows, cost and the prompt cache, each marked measured or estimated, with a band only when a figure crosses a line.

    /plugin install meter --marketplace LeSplooch/tbaguette-skills
    Meet meter→

  • ordersv0.1.0

    Say it once: the mod keeps a session's standing orders and puts them back in front of the model after every compaction.

    /plugin install orders --marketplace LeSplooch/tbaguette-skills
    Meet orders→

  • restv0.1.0

    Pause every session with one command: each holds its next tool call with no model running, then resumes where it stopped, and nothing is lost.

    /plugin install rest --marketplace LeSplooch/tbaguette-skills
    Meet rest→

  • watchv0.1.1

    Wait with no model running: the mod watches a usage ceiling or runs a check command on a timer, stays silent, and tells the session once, when it should.

    /plugin install watch --marketplace LeSplooch/tbaguette-skills
    Meet watch→
